learning_objectives.en: Follow names, addresses, price changes and viewing arrangements.
learning_objectives.vi: Nghe tên, địa chỉ, tiền thuê được cập nhật và lịch xem nhà.

strategies.en: Replay at natural speed, write the evidence phrase, then compare with the full transcript. Do not read the transcript before first attempt.
strategies.vi: Nghe tốc độ tự nhiên, ghi cụm bằng chứng, đối chiếu transcript sau lần làm đầu. Không đọc transcript ngay từ đầu.

mini_review.en: Can I explain why an earlier number was rejected?
mini_review.vi: Tôi có chỉ ra được vì sao một con số ban đầu bị thay đổi không?

mini_review.en: Can I explain each number or name from an audio transcript?
mini_review.vi: Tôi có thể tìm con số hoặc tên đúng trong transcript?

audios.title: U01_Listening_2
audios.transcript:
Agent: Hillside Lettings, Mark speaking.
Student: Hi, I saw an advert for a room in a shared flat on Carlton Road. Is it still available?
Agent: It is. It’s a double room on the second floor of a four-bedroom flat. Can I take your name?
Student: Yes, it’s Lena Okafor. That’s O-K-A-F-O-R.
Agent: Thanks, Lena. The flat is at number forty-three Carlton Road, about ten minutes on foot from the main campus.
Student: And how much is the rent?
Agent: The advert says five hundred pounds a month, but that’s out of date. The landlord has just lowered it to four hundred and seventy-five, and that includes water and internet. Electricity is shared between the tenants.
Student: That’s good. How many other people live there?
Agent: Three at the moment – two postgraduate students and a nurse who works night shifts at the hospital.
Student: Is there anywhere to keep a bicycle?
Agent: There’s a locked shed in the back garden. There’s no parking for cars, but there’s a bus stop right outside.
Student: When could I move in?
Agent: The current tenant leaves at the end of August, so the room is free from the first of September. You’d need to pay a deposit of one month’s rent before then.
Student: Could I see the room first?
Agent: Of course. I can show you round on Thursday at five, or Friday morning if that’s easier.
Student: Thursday at five is fine.
Agent: Great. Can I have a phone number in case anything changes?
Student: It’s oh-seven-seven-one, double four nine, three-one-two.
Agent: Thanks. And one more thing: please bring some photo identification to the viewing.
Student: No problem. See you on Thursday.

instruction.en: Play the supplied original practice MP3; complete notes without reading the transcript first.
instruction.vi: Nghe MP3 luyện tập mới được cung cấp, hoàn thành ghi chú; không đọc transcript trước.

questions.explanation_en: The student spells the surname O-K-A-F-O-R.
The agent confirms the address is 43 Carlton Road.
The advertisement said £500, but the new monthly rent is £475.
questions.explanation_vi: £500 là giá cũ trên quảng cáo; giá mới là “four hundred and seventy-five”.

questions.prompt_vi: Giá thuê bao gồm nước và ____
questions.explanation_en: Water and internet are included; electricity is paid separately.
questions.explanation_vi: “includes water and internet”; electricity không bao gồm.

questions.prompt_en: Occupation of one current tenant (works night shifts): ______
questions.prompt_vi: Nghề của một người thuê phòng đang làm ca đêm: ____
questions.explanation_en: The agent says one current tenant is a nurse on night shifts.

questions.prompt_en: Bicycles can be kept in a locked ______
questions.prompt_vi: Có thể cất xe đạp trong ____ có khóa
questions.explanation_en: There is a locked shed in the back garden for bicycles.
questions.explanation_vi: “a locked shed in the back garden”.

questions.explanation_en: The room is available from the first of September.
questions.explanation_vi: “the room is free from the first of September”.

questions.prompt_vi: Lịch xem phòng: thứ Năm lúc ____
questions.explanation_en: The viewing is confirmed for Thursday at five o’clock.
questions.explanation_vi: “Thursday at five is fine.” – 5 hoặc 5 pm.

questions.prompt_vi: Cần mang theo giấy tờ nhận dạng có ____
questions.explanation_en: The agent asks the student to bring photo identification.
questions.explanation_vi: “please bring some photo identification” – chấp nhận ID.

exercises.title: Accommodation: avoid the old advertised price

instruction.en: Identify the updated amount, which differs from the earlier advertisement.
instruction.vi: Xác định giá mới khác giá được quảng cáo cũ.

questions.prompt_en: What is the confirmed monthly rent?
questions.prompt_vi: Tiền thuê tháng đã được xác nhận là bao nhiêu?
questions.explanation_en: The agent explicitly corrects the earlier advertised £500 to £475.
questions.explanation_vi: Nhân viên nói £500 đã cũ, giá mới là £475.
